Property.PublicRemarks: Located in this most coveted West Bay neighborhood of West Vancouver this magnificent residence, designed by architect Russell Hollingsworth, is situated on one of the most prized waterfront properties in Greater Vancouver boasting over 200 feet of natural shoreline together with its own private boat house. Experience 180 degree unobstructed south facing views from this .9 acre private oceanfront estate with its walk out covered dining terrace, swimming pool with waterfall, jacuzzi spa, oceanfront massage table with outdoor shower and fireside seating areas. Floor to ceiling windows and glass doors bathe the home in natural light creating a serene, open feel with truly dramatic effect and offering a wonderful indoor outdoor lifestyle experience. Each principal living area boasts spectacular garden and ocean views providing one of the most sensational settings imaginable... The main residence provides approximately 10,000 square feet of living space on two expansive levels featuring five full bedroom suites including a privately situated guest suite. Additional features include a lower level media room, private office, temperature controlled wine room, exercise room, crafts or hobby room together with air conditioning, security and music that sets the standard for an active and truly sophisticated lifestyle. This fully gated waterfront estate is professionally landscaped with private courtyards, walkways, gated entry with garage parking for 4 vehicles. All illuminated at nighttime with dramatic effect and designed in complete harmony with the design of this magnificent luxury waterfront residence.

Located in West Vancouver’s Dundarave neighbourhood this brilliantly designed modern residence by architectural firm MCLEOD BOVELL is a rare example of high performance construction masterfully designed in a park-like setting and situated on this uniquely positioned beachfront property. Exceptional quality featuring exposed concrete and steel construction together with an impeccable choice of quality materials define this brilliantly designed five bedroom, five and one half bathroom modern residence. Floor to ceiling windows and glass doors bathe the home in natural light and create an ethereal, open feel with truly dramatic effect with each principal living area providing spectacular ocean views in one of the most sensational settings imaginable.. The professionally landscaped property is fully gated with garage parking for up to 6 vehicles with heated driveway and illuminated at nighttime with dramatic effect.

THE LABYRINTH - An architectural masterpiece by renowned architect Russell Hollingsworth situated on a private 1.48 acre estate property with breathtaking ocean vistas and sunsets. Experience over 11,800 square feet of living space in your own private oasis. Floor to ceiling windows and glass doors bathe the home in natural light creating a serene, open feel with truly dramatic effect and offering a wonderful indoor outdoor lifestyle experience like no other with private terraces, beautiful water features and private forest with walking trails. Features Include: 6 bedroom suites, 8 bathrooms, air conditioning, Indoor Swimming Pool and Garage Parking for 4 vehicles.

The King Georges Estate is a European inspired World Class luxury residence situated on a .68 acre property in West Vancouver’s most exclusive British Properties. Developed by Trilliant Homes the residence spans over eleven thousand square feet across three levels with seven bedroom suites, eight and one half bathrooms providing ample space for family and guests. The grand rotunda driveway adorned with modern art sculptures and multiple water features, welcomes you home in spectacular fashion together with an 8 car subterranean garage. The main floor of King Georges Estate is a marvel of design and technology. Italian door hardware from Glass Design, featuring magnetic actuators, sets the tone for a residence where every detail has been carefully considered. Smart home technology is integrated throughout, with 10-foot touchscreen displays on each floor and custom sound-deadening doors ensuring a peaceful environment. The gourmet kitchen, a chef’s dream, boasts Italian decorative lights, Lutron blinds, and top-of-the-line appliances from Gaggenau, Miele, and Wolf. The entertainment spaces are equally impressive, with a grand living room fireplace and a custom Manta Italian chandelier illuminating the space. Ascending to the upper floor, the sense of luxury continues. Four en-suite bedrooms offer sanctuary-like spaces, each complemented by vaulted ceilings and stunning interiors. A family room provides a cozy retreat, perfect for intimate gatherings or quiet moments of relaxation. The ground floor is dedicated to wellness and leisure, featuring a gym, sauna, steam room, and bar lounge. Here, you can unwind after a long day or entertain guests in style. The Ernestomeda wine room and state of the art home theatre add an extra touch of sophistication, making every movie night or wine-tasting an event to remember. For those who appreciate the ease of modern convenience, a glass elevator effortlessly transports you between floors, while the glass-encased floating staircase stands as a striking architectural feature. Outside, the estate continues to impress. An infinity-edge saltwater pool and spa invite you to relax in the tranquil waters, while the outdoor kitchen, lounge, and fireplace provide the perfect setting for al fresco dining and entertainment. The meticulously landscaped grounds, designed by Paul Sangha Design feature cascading waterfalls and is illuminated at nighttime with dramatic effect.

In West Vancouver’s exclusive Whitby Estates, this world-class residence commands sweeping 180-degree ocean views from downtown Vancouver and Stanley Park to Vancouver Island’s majestic peaks. With five luxurious bedroom suites and eight bathrooms, including a private lower-level guest suite, it masterfully balances grand-scale entertaining with refined daily living. Highlights include expansive principal rooms, two sensational chef’s kitchens paired with an outdoor kitchen, and a dedicated entertainment level featuring a stylish wet bar, temperature-controlled wine display, state-of-the-art home theatre, Technogym fitness studio, and elegant private office, all integrated with Crestron smart automation. Just 15 minutes from downtown Vancouver and under 90 minutes to Whistler, this iconic estate epitomizes refined coastal luxury, where breathtaking natural beauty and sophisticated design create an extraordinary lifestyle.

Nestled in the exclusive Sunridge Plateau neighborhood, this brilliantly designed modern residence sits majestically on a private hillside lot offering breathtaking views of the Sproatt and Rainbow mountain ranges, the Whistler Golf Course and the picturesque Whistler Valley below. Spanning approximately 8,000 square feet of living across three levels, this six-bedroom, seven-bathroom architectural masterpiece delivers an expansive open-concept living experience. Defined by soaring high ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows and an impeccable selection of modern designer finishes, the residence captures the essence of a sophisticated modern luxury chalet with its convenient ski-in access. Features include an indoor swimming pool, spa bathroom, massage room, fabulous gym and much more.

Penthouse 2 at Alberni by Kengo Kuma is an extraordinary three-level, three bedroom residence perched 43 storeys above Downtown Vancouver. Experience nearly 5,800 SQ FT of refined indoor-outdoor living with sweeping 270° views of Coal Harbour, Stanley Park, and North Shore Mountains. Highlights include entertainment size principal rooms, 20ft ceilings in the living area, sensational gourmet kitchen, formal dining, media room and large primary bedroom suite with en-suite bathroom and terrace with soaking tub. A glass elevator connects all 3 levels to a private rooftop terrace featuring a glass-bottom pool and spa. Additional amenities include 5-car garage parking, storage, bike and wine lockers, and world-class facilities with concierge, indoor pool and jacuzzi, sauna, gym, and music room.

A truly extraordinary opportunity to acquire one of West Vancouver’s most remarkable waterfront properties. Set on approximately 0.64 acres with an estimated 235ft of natural shoreline, this vacant oceanfront building site offers a rare canvas for a world-class luxury residence in one of the city’s most prized locations. Proposed architectural plans and renderings by world-renowned Arno Matis Architecture envision the striking “Yacht House,” designed to integrate dramatically with the site’s natural rock formations, topography, and waterfront setting. Sweeping 180° city, ocean, and sunset views, combined with exceptional privacy and a direct connection to the shoreline, create an irreplaceable setting for a once in a generation architectural masterpiece on a landmark waterfront estate.

Akasha is one of Whistler's most iconic and architecturally significant mountain estates, a luxurious ski-in chalet poised on the prestigious Sunridge Plateau. This masterpiece of luxury craftsmanship is defined by a majestic 400-year-old red cedar tree rising through the center of its grand spiral staircase blending rustic elegance with timeless design. This 6 bedroom, 7 bathroom luxury chalet offers unparalleled amenities for a world-class alpine experience, making it the ultimate private sanctuary just a short walk to Whistler Village. Additional features include a state-of-the-art media room, wine cellar, spectacular spa with an indoor lap pool and cascading waterfall, a steam room, outdoor hot tub carved from stone - all offering sweeping views of the Whistler Valley.

Set within the coveted Sheerwater enclave, Mont des Cieux — winner of the 2023 Home of the Year from the Okanagan Housing Awards of Excellence — delivers the pinnacle of lakefront living. This 10,000-square-foot custom-built estate is thoughtfully positioned for maximum privacy and sweeping views across Okanagan Lake. Built predominantly from steel, concrete, and glass, the home carries a refined warmth throughout. A glass elevator links each level with ease. The great room impresses with towering ceilings and floor-to-ceiling glazing, flooding the interior with light and calm. Outside, an infinity-edge pool overlooks the lake, while a hillside lounge beside a tiled pond and waterfall offers a quieter retreat. Advanced mechanical systems, solar power, and a full Crestron automation suite mark this as a standout property in the region. Global craftsmanship abounds: triple-pane windows from Austria, glazing from Germany, millwork from Italy, furnishings from Australia, and gym equipment from Poland. With three primary suites, a state-of-the-art theatre, and a 300-plus-bottle wine cellar, Mont des Cieux delivers refined, elevated living. Complete the Okanagan lifestyle with private lakefront access and your own boat slip at the exclusive wharf.

Award winning modern mansion designed by David Christopher and Paul Sangha and built by award-winning Marble Construction. A 2026 HAVAN Award winner and finalist at the Georgie Awards and National Housing Awards, this one of a kind residence offers over 10,340 SQF on a flat, south facing property with natural light and privacy. Enjoy views of Lions Gate Bridge, downtown Vancouver, the ocean, UBC, and Vancouver Island to the west. A bold roofline, oversized aluminum framed windows and wide openings create seamless indoor/outdoor living. Inside, double height ceilings and refined interiors feature rare materials. An infinity edge pool, spa, theatre, elevator, oversized kitchen, wok kitchen and five covered parking spaces, including a three car collector's car garage, complete the home.

Perched in exclusive Sunridge Plateau—Whistler’s most coveted luxury complex is walking distance to Whistler village center—this 7,000+ square-foot masterwork redefines mountain estate. Architecturally designed to prioritize volume and transparency, this home offers a sophisticated, open-concept experience that connects you directly to the sweeping valley vistas. The massive structural golden cedar logs frame the soaring ceilings. The expansive glass walls create a gallery-like atmosphere that remains warm and inviting. Every detail is intentional here. A full-height elevator services all three levels. The garage organizes your entire fleet—from powder skis and mountain bikes to watercraft—ensuring you are always ready for the next adventure. Ski-in trail is within steps at the cul-de-sac

The street gives nothing away. In the back, the land opens onto half an acre of sun, privacy and meticulously landscaped grounds. A West Coast residence by Marque Thompson w/ interiors by Raven Inside. The great room rises twenty feet through black-framed glazing as you enter, Bocci pendants above a floor-to-ceiling travertine hearth. White oak underfoot, cedar overhead, floating oak-and-steel stairs, elevator to every level. Scavolini and Gaggenau in book-matched stone. Featuring 6 beds, 8 baths. Outside lives as its own luxury retreat: terraced gardens, 30' heated pool, hot tub, outdoor kitchen, fire pit, covered lanai. Below, a wing dedicated to movement: regulation squash court beneath 20' ceilings, fully equipped gym, pilates studio, cedar sauna and steam. A true private family estate

Serenity" in Whistler. Nestled in a quiet cul-de-sac is this incredibly 5900 sqft custom-built timeless construction with the best craftsmanship & finest quality materials. A 2/3 acre private flat lot with a manicured yard & gardens of a profusion of flowers in summer. The house is well-designed with amazing details. The main living area is both intimate & opulent, centered on a two-story masonry wood-burning fireplace faced in natural Basalt. South-facing floor-to-ceiling windows flood the home with abundant natural light. Centered on the living and dining area, the main floor has a kitchen & family area in the east wing and an office and entertainment area in the east wing, and an office and entertainment area in the west. 5 bedrooms plus a huge kid's playroom makes this a dream home.

Discover the ultimate entertainer’s retreat in this exceptional custom-built chalet, where timeless craftsmanship meets contemporary alpine living. Offering the flexibility of 6 full bedrooms, including five with private ensuites, and 2 flex rooms/dens, this remarkable residence is designed for effortless comfort and memorable gatherings. Soaring vaulted ceilings, exposed timber beams, and walls of glass fill the home with natural light and mountain ambiance. The chef’s kitchen flows seamlessly into the Great Room and a generous outdoor living space complete with a wood-burning fireplace. Enjoy a private fitness room, home theatre, games room with wet bars, and a relaxing hot tub. Just a short stroll from Alta Lake and moments from Whistler Village and Creekside lifts.

Step into sophistication and luxury in the heart of Whistler's coveted White Gold neighbourhood. This west coast contemporary masterpiece, built in 2023, boasts 3577 sq ft of flawlessly crafted living space over two levels. With 4 bedrooms, 2 family rooms, and 5 baths, it offers unparalleled elegance and comfort. Sun-drenched interiors reveal breathtaking views of Blackcomb & Whistler mountains, complemented by a cozy wood burning fireplace and radiant in-floor heating. Meticulously designed, every detail exudes perfection, from the exquisite architecture to the curated interiors. Enjoy the convenience of walking distance to the main village, Lost Lake trails, and Nesters marketplace. Welcome to your Diamond in White Gold.

Set on a private, gated 17,000+ sq.ft. estate in coveted Altamont, this fully reimagined 6,700+ sq.ft. 5-bedroom, 8-bathroom residence by Gillian Segal is a rare design-forward offering where architectural precision meets layered warmth. Checkerboard marble floors, bespoke millwork, plaster walls and curated colour blocking define luminous interiors enhanced by elevated designer lighting. The kitchen pairs micro-cement counters, custom cabinetry, a La Cornue range and Liebherr appliances with multiple dishwashers and beverage fridges for effortless entertaining. Two custom bars anchor the entertaining levels. Resort-style pool and spa, wine cellar, gym, playroom, infrared sauna, massive storage, new boiler and Crestron automation complete this exceptional Altamont estate.

This Luxury Residence at Landmark on Robson sits 29 Floors above Downtown Vancouver with 270° city, ocean, and mountain views. Experience a sophisticated and luxurious lifestyle, designed by Ikebuchi Interior, boasting over 3,000 SQ. FT. of indoor-outdoor living from this four bedroom and four bathroom residence. Experience an impeccable choice of luxury features including custom feature wood walls and closets, integrated cove lighting, Gaggenau Appliances (3 Refrigerators), motorized blinds and a expansive Primary Suite with dual closets and spa like ensuite. Club Robson offers over 18,000 SQ. Ft. of amenities that are highlighted by an ozone pool, fitness and yoga room, and 24HR concierge. This residence also offers two private double car garages and two private storage lockers.

Perched majestically on a magnificent .96 acre waterfront estate, this West Coast timbered masterpiece redefines coastal elegance with its seamless fusion of raw nature and refined craftsmanship. This extraordinary custom built oceanfront residence is a symphony of heavy Douglas fir timbers, their rich grain exposed in soaring, vaulted ceilings that frame unobstructed Pacific vistas providing a wonderful indoor outdoor living experience like no other. The open-concept floor plan provides entertainment size principal rooms. Each of the 5 bedrooms feels like a serene retreat enveloped by the rhythmic pulse of the ocean below. Terraced gardens cascade down the bluff blurring the line between architecture and landscape.

Luminescence, a distinguished Japanese Modern nestled in Sheerwater, Kelowna’s premier gated waterfront community. From the moment you arrive, Sheerwater distinguishes itself. It is a celebration of design, nature, and privacy - a sanctuary where life is lived with intention and distinction. Set on 2.15 acres, nineteen offers exclusive lakeside access with a private marina and unobstructed lake vistas. Its three-story Genkan foyer creates a calming transition from the outdoors. Crafted from concrete, brick, glass, and timber, the residence showcases open interiors filled with natural light. Water features inside and outside create a sense of serenity. The sun terrace, accessible from the great room and primary suite, offers stunning 180-degree lake views and romantic sunsets. Wider than the home itself, the terrace includes multiple outdoor lounge areas, an outdoor kitchen, numerous gas-lit fire features, and a pool deck that seamlessly flows into an infinity pool color-matched to Okanagan Lake. Inside, a series of rooms offer mesmerizing views of exterior water features through clear aquarium panels. Additionally, a lush and private courtyard is off the sunlit, professional-grade kitchen. Built to commercial standards, every detail reflects exceptional craftsmanship, exemplified by the two-story garage with a vehicle lounge, and a spacious passenger elevator. Recognized with awards for home design, primary suite, and luxury pool, Luminescence defines visionary.
